definitions.gloss: excellent idea; brilliant plan; bright suggestion
definitions.explanation: A particularly good or clever idea or plan. Often used when someone comes up with an unexpectedly effective solution.

examples.japanese: それは{名案|めいあん}だ！
{何|なに}か{名案|めいあん}はありませんか。
examples.english: Do you have any good ideas?

examples.japanese: みんなで{話|はな}し{合|あ}ったら、{名案|めいあん}が{浮|う}かんだ。
examples.english: When we all talked it over, a brilliant idea came to us.

notes:
USAGE:
{名案|めいあん} is an approving term for a clever or effective idea. It is often used as an exclamation when someone suggests a good plan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名案|めいあん}が{浮|う}かぶ (a brilliant idea comes to mind)
- {名案|めいあん}が{出|で}る (a good idea emerges)
- {名案|めいあん}を{思|おも}いつく (to think of an excellent idea)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{妙案|みょうあん} also means a clever idea, but implies an even more ingenious or unexpected quality. {良案|りょうあん} is a more neutral "good plan" without the emphatic praise of {名案|めいあん}.
